name: Itsu made mo... ~Kaminaga-san-chi no Shunkashuutou~
original_name: いつまでも・・・～神長さん家の春夏秋冬～
source:
Main character lives in a Shinto priest family with three of priest daughters. One day priest disappears leaving a short notice letter. At the same time hero feels a desire for his first love Ryoko. He seeks relations either inside or outside the family not with words, but with warmth.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角生活在一个神道教牧师家庭，有三个牧师女儿。有一天，牧师失踪了，留下了一封简短的通知信。与此同时，英雄对他的初恋凉子产生了渴望。他寻求家庭内外的关系，不是用言语，而是用温暖。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
